text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
...Haaah...
haaah...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (Oooooh!)

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
"Incredible! This year's Derby Umamusume
showed some real guts!"

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text: Yeah, yeah, it was super exciting! The Oaks was so incredible that I was a little worried about how the Derby would hold up, though.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: ...? The "Oaks"?

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
I know! Her running style is practically a breathtaking view in itself!
Once you see it, you can never forget it!!

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
Apparently she's already registered for the Prix de l'Arc de Triomphe, too.
Seriously, she's on a whole other level.

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
Ah, remembering it makes me
want to watch it again.
Her star quality is just insane!

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
…………
...Seriously?

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
...Then this Derby wasn't as amazing
as the Oaks, huh.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: ......Really?

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text:
...What are you gonna do?
About Nakayama Festa's interview.

text_block_list.name: Reporter B
text_block_list.text:
I'll take it for now.
Though my real target is the Yushun Himba (Japanese Oaks)—

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Can you believe it?
This is *after* the Derby, man.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Well, you were talking big before that, too.
Results alone aren't gonna win people's trust.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
"Looks like I won't be able to turn the tables
unless I prove an absolute strength
worthy of their hopes and expectations."

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
In that respect,
the Oaks Umamusume seems to make the grade.
5 wins in 6 starts, and she was the 1st favorite in every single race.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: Well, she's certainly a talent worthy of being a heroine.
choice_data_list: You've definitely been getting stronger too.
You've definitely been getting stronger too.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Creeping up slowly like that just won't cut it.
In the end, what grabs everyone's attention
is a flashy burst of light, like fireworks.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: In fact, we pulled a stunt like that too, didn't we? Crashing El's press conference to declare our rivalry.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: Thanks to that, she drew passionate gazes during her debut race as well, but—

text_block_list.name: Press Corps
text_block_list.text: (Whisper, whisper...)

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: Looks like the effect is wearing off about now.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
As time passes, only the genuine remains.
A fleeting wave quickly turns into foam.
Only unshakable, true ability will—

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Heh-heh... You've been quite something yourself
ever since the day we met.
choice_data_list: Let's show them what you're made of at the Kikuka Sho.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Yeah. 3,000 meters on Kyoto's turf.
It'll be a great race to prove I've got the stamina to run on European turf.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: ...I gotta at least place in the top three.

text_block_list.name: TV Audio
text_block_list.text: "Well now, we've had the Classic-tier Umamusume showing off their true talent once again this year."

text_block_list.name: TV Audio
text_block_list.text: "Yes, absolutely! Especially that girl making such a breakthrough along the Tiara route! We have high hopes for her~! Now, moving on to our next news—"

text_block_list.name: Nakayama's Former Homeroom Teacher
text_block_list.text: ...Fes... ta.

text_block_list.name: Doctor
text_block_list.text: Excuse me. How are you feeling?

text_block_list.name: Nakayama's Former Homeroom Teacher
text_block_list.text: Tea... ch...

text_block_list.name: Doctor
text_block_list.text:
...My apologies.
You don't have to push yourself.

text_block_list.name: Doctor
text_block_list.text:
We must soon consider the next stage.
Please discuss the treatment plan we talked about
with your father.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama's Former Homeroom Teacher
text_block_list.text: ...Yes.
